reference.role: Drawing-language authority; not identity, body or costume template

candidates.prompt:
Original Zuric exploration for SOULMONSTERS. Attached Kael is reference for DRAWING LANGUAGE ONLY: very fine dark manga line, flat local colors, one economical small cel-shadow, simple noses/mouths, clear eyelids, few functional folds. Preserve that clean hand-drawn 2D manga rendering, but give Zuric his own ADULT face, body and hairstyle. This is an exploratory sketch sheet, some spare construction lines allowed, not a glossy finished model sheet. White landscape paper. No scenery, gradients, painterly muscles, realistic leather or realistic motor rendering. Treat person and motorcycle with equally economical 2D linework. No Pokémon character copies.
Composition: one LARGE FULL-BODY standing character on left, one clear HEAD study upper right, and one SMALLER FULL-BODY action vignette lower right of SAME character actually using his complete two-wheel motorcycle (both wheels, feet, hands, support believable). Small handwritten title top left. No back-view, no redundant expression gallery, no text paragraphs. All drawings fully inside margins.
Fixed USER requirements: ZURIC is a HUMAN MALE MOTORCYCLIST in BLACK LEATHER with assertive motorcycle-gang attitude; visual inspiration from Brazilian headless-mule folklore. He has an intact human head. Translate the myth into shapes, weight, negative space and equipment, not merely little horseshoe badges/flame stickers. His bike is a compact real-looking small custom street motorcycle structurally, but drawn in simple 2D manga, not a huge photoreal superbike. One small kite-line reel can connect to Soulmonsters, keep accessories sparse.
TITLE "Zuric A · Breu". A SHORT STOCKY 28-year-old man, warm medium-brown skin, very WIDE BARREL TORSO, short thick legs, a head tucked slightly forward, rounded heavy upper eyelids and long small squared chin; a BROAD slightly long nose and asymmetrical lower lip, not Kael's heroic teen face. Short black hair is a low blunt uneven forward fringe, back cropped, absolutely NOT a swept-up spiked crest; one pale narrow horizontal temple stripe. His mouth is a closed small challenging smirk and the eyes look sideways from under relaxed low brows. Main unforgettable shape: enormously wide BLACK LEATHER funnel collar curving up BEHIND the jaw and head; collar FRONT is deeply U-CUT so a clean ivory strip of undershirt and dark NECK NEGATIVE SPACE interrupt the broad shoulder mass. Head is clearly visible, collar does not become a helmet. Think hollow neck silhouette echoing the headless mule without making him headless. Jacket short and boxy, big smooth sleeves, one fastening across lower torso. Inner collar has ONE broad irregular ember-red fold, like a single flame tongue, not a row of spikes. Heavy dark knee-length riding trousers, calf-high boots with wide simple hooflike squared soles and a crescent exposed heel guard; thin line, no painted metal. Black/ivory/oxblood three graphic masses. Left-standing pose hunched forward feet apart, forearms hanging loosely between elbows raised outward, compact threatening weight, not hands on hips. Head closeup must show distinctive broad nose, droopy eyelids and tucked chin. Riding vignette: same low compact man astride LOW SHORT bobber, both boots planted flat, knees bent visibly outward, elbows forward leaning on LOW handlebar; tank low under belly, bike and body make single heavy compact silhouette. Bike has a large empty curved U front-fork brace with small recessed lamp and low single saddle, no giant horse head or flames. Show rider fits bike.

TITLE "Zuric B · Ferrador". A SHORT POWERFULLY BUILT 33-year-old man, medium warm-brown skin, disproportionately LARGE FOREARMS AND HANDS, thick torso, slightly bowed strong SHORT legs; head small relative to shoulders. Square broad jaw with a short broad flat nose, wide low straight mouth corner tugged down on one side, very SMALL oval manga irises under thick horizontal eyebrows; ONE thin curved sideburn connects to short dark chin stubble, gently stylized adult manga, no rendered muscle. Hair is cropped black with a single ROUND curl falling forward on shaved forehead, not spikes or orange dye. Black leather motorcycle WORK JACKET with sleeves folded above elbows and broad round shoulders. One LARGE HORSESHOE-SHAPED STRUCTURAL bronze waist buckle fastens a broad leather protective split apron over dark short riding trousers; apron split into TWO asymmetrical rounded panels (one to thigh, one to knee), heavy boots. Design weight is forearms and low apron, NOT collar or hairstyle. Muted black/warm beige/rusted bronze colors, tiny cream shirt strip, leather matte and simply drawn. Standing: feet planted wide, head turned, one enormous gloved hand rests on a real curved mechanical bracket and other hand pinches a tiny knot of kite line with unexpected delicacy; dominant rough-biker attitude with precise mechanic gesture, not a comic dwarf. Head study recognizably own face. Lower-right action: one boot on ground, other knee bent beside bike as he TIGHTENS a side screw with short wrench, leaning toward a squat utilitarian motorcycle. Bike has one large U heat shield functioning at side, low frame and broad sprung saddle, wheels aligned and sensible joints. No flame decals, no giant decorative exhaust, no weapon. Folklore comes from hoof impact weight, rounded iron structural arcs and smoky black leather.

TITLE "Zuric C · Encruzilhada". A TALL VERY THIN 26-year-old man with warm medium-brown skin, narrow slanted shoulders held unevenly and a long subtly crooked spine. Very LONG NARROW FACE and longer nose bridge, one naturally heavy half-closed eyelid and the other eye more open, low wide mouth curved only at one corner, angular but not realistic manga construction. Lower face longer than Kael; long neck apparent. Black hair has a long heavy SIDE-FALLING LOW fringe covering part of one eyebrow and slick FLAT crown, NOT spikes or pompadour. One single thin pale lock behind ear, no orange hair. Black leather biker jacket SHORT AT FRONT but one large LONG BACK PANEL sweeping toward calf like a dragging dark mule tail, no separate ribbons. One shoulder slightly extended, jacket loose around ribs, high slim trousers, long narrow pointed-toe riding boots with ankle straps shaped like stirrups, no cowboy costume. Bone-white small silk scarf wraps neck but end is tucked in and collar low; single rusty-red lining visible only under back panel, no flames everywhere. Black/ivory/dark rust color masses. Standing pose leaning strongly on ONE hip with one shoulder raised, wrists limp and one knuckle gently resting against chin, sly half-lidded challenging glance, heel touching ground, peculiar reserved gang attitude not heroic arms-crossed. Head closeup shows uneven eyelids, elongated jaw, side fringe. Riding vignette: character seated sideways on a slender small street tracker, one long leg grounded and other bent across the seat, one hand rests on handlebar and he turns toward viewer over raised shoulder; the back leather panel drops with gravity behind seat, does not intersect wheel. Bike low and lean, one asymmetrical crescent front lamp and single rear splashguard echo tail shape, not animal. Clear difference from short heavy A and B. No skulls, chains, spikes or flame decals.

Refine Zuric candidate A into the EXACT clean simple 2D manga rendering of IMAGE 1 (Kael), preserving the ORIGINAL CHARACTER IDENTITY and pose architecture from IMAGE 2 (Zuric A). This is a STYLE CORRECTION and simplification, not another redesign and not a recolor.
White landscape paper, same layout as image2: large FULL BODY Zuric standing left, head portrait upper right, same Zuric seated on his complete compact motorcycle lower right. Entire boots and both wheels included. Small handwritten heading "Zuric · Breu" only. The bike and character use equally simple manga rendering.
LOCK from image2: warm brown skin; short stocky broad barrel torso and relatively short strong legs; short uneven BLACK forward fringe, pale horizontal stripe at anatomical LEFT temple; broad slightly long nose, half-lidded oval eyes looking sideways, low thick eyebrows, short squared chin and understated challenging closed smile; NO teen hero face. Huge broad curved black leather collar rises BEHIND visible head and curves round shoulders, FRONT open deep U with dark inset below chin, ivory shirt strip. Collar has ONE broad oxblood red inner fold like an irregular flame tongue. Cropped boxy black leather jacket, charcoal loose riding trousers, chunky simple squared riding boots with crescent ivory heel guards, single attached small kite reel at left hip. Biker gang stance hunched forwards, elbows away from torso, feet wide, hands loose. Preserve heavy compact silhouette, not tall slender.
PRIMARY CHANGE: thin delicate DARK GREY lines with very little lineweight difference. Use ONLY FLAT local base colors and ONE small crisp cel shadow per material, exactly the simplicity of Kael model sheet. Large areas of unbroken flat cloth and skin. Reduce garment crease count by at least half: only 1-2 folds at elbow, a few at knees/waist. Draw neck simply, no outlined muscle/tendon shading. No painterly volume or gradients anywhere. MATTE black leather, no specular shine patches, no surface texture, no metallic 3D highlights. Skin one flat base plus small under-chin shadow. Hair a few solid masses without dozens of etched spikes. Make features delicate lines while keeping his distinctive adult proportions. No crosshatching. Thin handmade manga line not thick cartoon contour.
Simplify outfit hardware to one broad lower-jacket closure and clean plain sleeve ends; remove unnecessary zippers, tiny rivets and dozens of belt loops. Keep ONE tasteful off-white broad sleeve stripe from image2.
Motorcycle in action vignette: same low short bobber, oxblood low saddle, black tank, large clean U-fork-brace shape, small inset low amber lamp, pale crescent-shaped rear exhaust HEAT SHIELD integrated as ONE solid panel. Engine should be readable as 3-4 large graphic masses with only a few straight cooling-fin lines, NOT dozens of tiny bolts/pipes. Tires smooth, a FEW spoke lines, no intricate tread. Both wrists grip the real low handlebar, forearms supported, both boots planted on ground with visibly bent knees. Body and tank make one low compact silhouette; physically attached forks, axles, frame, wheels. No floating parts, no extra foot or duplicate arms.
Keep head whole, no skulls, no actual flames. The legend is interpreted through collar's hollow dark neck region, hooflike weight and restrained red lining. Use flat white background. Clean manga animation model artwork, not western cartoon, photorealistic biker illustration or gritty action anime poster.

selection.chosenBy: agent for refinement; not artistic approval by user
selection.reason: Gola larga, corpo compacto e pose sobre moto traduzem ausência/vazio no pescoço e peso como conjunto; afastamento estrutural da V1.

alternatives.b: Ofício e rosto mais próprios; musculatura, textura e detalhe mecânico excedem o alvo Kael.
alternatives.c: Figura diagonal e cabeça mais próprias; ainda próxima do rival esguio habitual e menos ligada à lenda.

review.performed: Visual inspection of all three generated candidates and refined A against Kael.
review.refinement: Menos dobras, menos brilho e detalhes na moto; grandes áreas de cor mais quietas. Mantém corpo, cabeça, gola e atitude de A.
review.limitations: Conceitos estáticos, sem ortográficas traseiras, sem teste de rig ou sprite e sem validação de engenharia da moto.

skill.action: Updated existing project skill; no global skill installation
skill.officialValidation: Attempted quick_validate.py; unavailable dependency PyYAML. Frontmatter and local references checked separately.
